description: Use this when the user already has a lot number and wants the profile Fonciq already holds: cadastre, assessment-roll value and previously retrieved index lines. Does not consult the Registre and retrieves no new index. Requires an authenticated Fonciq account. / Exige un compte Fonciq authentifié. This lookup costs nothing and consults no Registre.  À utiliser quand le numéro de lot est connu : fiche conservée, sans nouveau tirage.
name: lot_get
